one_liner: PitchBook offers a REST API with token‑based auth and premium connectors via SSO.
gating_notes: Access requires a licensed PitchBook account and SSO authentication for connectors; API access is granted by the Direct Data team.
oauth_details: Authentication is performed via SSO for connectors; API uses bearer tokens or API keys.

auth_methods.quote: The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser. Every call will use the same base URL: https://api.pitchbook.com/

primary_auth.quote: Our team will work with you to understand the insights and data you’re looking for and help you establish the API connection through an API key or authentication token.

credential_access.quote: reach out to our Direct Data team to request access to the API.

api_type.quote: The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser.

api_breadth.quote: The API solution offers a variety of relational endpoints, including financing details, deal stock information, as well as AI-powered VC exit predictor data.

existing_mcp.quote: AI partners connect securely to PitchBook’s Premium Connector (built on MCP server technology) directly through the partner’s site.
